G_definition: g298; total molecular Gibbs free energy at 298.15 K, not g298_atom or solvation free energy
smiles_policy: RDKit canonical non-isomeric SMILES for all three routes; keep isomeric SMILES for provenance
duplicate_policy: Keep smallest original QM9 ID for each canonical non-isomeric SMILES, without consulting targets
input_information: 2D connectivity only; SDF coordinates are not model inputs
data_caveat: This is the RDKit-valid subset of the DeepChem SDF mirror, with additional parsing exclusions. It must not be described as the standard 130831-molecule QM9 subset. Original-SMILES cross-check is pending.
